verifications.claim: Fátima is located in Portugal.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'village of Fatima, Portugal'; R2: 'Fátima... in the municipality of Ourém... Portugal'; R3: 'Fátima, Portugal'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly state Fátima is in Portugal.

verifications.claim: The 1917 Marian apparitions were witnessed by three shepherd children Lúcia Santos, Francisco Marto, and Jacinta Marto.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'three young peasant children: Francisco, Jacinta, and Lucia'; R2: 'three local children, Lúcia dos Santos and her cousins, Francisco and Jacinta Marto'; R3: 'three shepherd children –Lúcia dos Santos, Francisco and Jacinta Marto'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm the three children and 1917 apparitions.

verifications.claim: Francisco Marto and Jacinta Marto were cousins of Lúcia Santos.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Lúcia dos Santos and her cousins, Francisco and Jacinta Marto'; R3: 'Lúcia dos Santos and her cousins Francisco and Jacinta Marto'
verifications.reasoning: R2 and R3 explicitly state they were cousins.

verifications.claim: The Lady of the Rosary revealed three secrets.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the “Secret,”... consists of three parts'; R3: 'Our Lady of the Holy Rosary of Fátima... three secrets'
verifications.reasoning: Sources identify her as Lady of the Rosary and confirm three secrets revealed.

verifications.claim: The three secrets focused on prayer.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: first secret 'urgent plea... for acts of prayer and sacrifice... praying of the rosary'
verifications.reasoning: Prayer emphasized in first secret and overall message, but not primary focus of all three secrets.

verifications.claim: The three secrets focused on a vision of hell.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The first part of the “Secret” was a frightening vision of hell'
verifications.reasoning: Only the first secret describes vision of hell; not all three.

verifications.claim: The three secrets focused on the need for devotion to her Immaculate Heart to prevent world conflicts.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: first 'devotion to the Immaculate Heart of Mary'; second 'prediction of the immense damage that Russia would do... if Her requests... obeyed'
verifications.reasoning: Devotion and prevention of conflicts (WWII) in first/second, but third focuses on suffering vision.

verifications.claim: The Miracle of the Sun occurred on October 13, 1917.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'October 13, 1917... “The Miracle of the Sun”'; R2: '13 October 1917... Miracle of the Sun'; R3: '13 October... "Miracle of the Sun"'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm date and name.

verifications.claim: Thousands witnessed the sun appearing to dance and fall on October 13, 1917.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'nearly 70,000 people... the huge ball began to “dance”... plunge... toward the earth'; R2: '70,000 pilgrims... Miracle of the Sun'; R3: 'huge crowd... Sun... spinning disc... careened towards the Earth'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe thousands witnessing dance/plunge on that date.

verifications.claim: Lúcia Santos was 10 years old.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Lucia; ages 10, 9 and 7'
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly states Lúcia's age as 10 in 1917.

verifications.claim: Francisco Marto was 9 years old.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Francisco... ages 10, 9 and 7' (Francisco 9)
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly attributes age 9 to Francisco.

verifications.claim: Jacinta Marto was 7 years old.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Jacinta... ages 10, 9 and 7' (Jacinta 7)
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly attributes age 7 to Jacinta.

verifications.claim: Lúcia Santos, Francisco Marto, and Jacinta Marto were tending sheep in the Cova da Iria when they saw the apparition.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'tending their family’s sheep... Cova da Iria'; R2: 'guarding their families' sheep in the Cova da Iria'; R3: 'three shepherd children... in Cova da Iria'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm tending sheep at Cova da Iria.

verifications.claim: The three secrets were revealed to the children in July 1917.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'confided to the children in July 1917'
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states July 1917.

verifications.claim: The secrets included a terrifying vision of hell.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first part... frightening vision of hell... terrifying'
verifications.reasoning: R1 confirms terrifying vision of hell in first secret.

verifications.claim: The secrets included a prophecy regarding World War II.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'second part... prophesied the outbreak of World War II'
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly states prophecy of WWII in second secret.

verifications.claim: The secrets included instructions to consecrate Russia to the Immaculate Heart of Mary.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'To prevent it, I shall come to ask for the consecration of Russia to my Immaculate Heart'
verifications.reasoning: R1 confirms instruction in second secret.

verifications.claim: The third secret included a long-hidden portion detailing a bishop in white navigating a damaged city of dead.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'third part... not revealed until 2000... “the Bishop clothed in white,”... makes his way... amid the corpses... city half in ruins'
verifications.reasoning: R1 describes third secret matching claim.

verifications.claim: The long-hidden portion of the third secret is interpreted as the Pope suffering in the church's struggle.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Sister Lucia... confirmed that... “the Bishop clothed in white,”... is the Pope... immense suffering endured by witnesses of the faith... Church’s continued struggle'
verifications.reasoning: R1 provides exact interpretation.

verifications.claim: About 50,000 to 100,000 people witnessed the Miracle of the Sun on October 13, 1917.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'nearly 70,000'; R2: 'estimated 70,000'; R3: 'possibly between 30,000 and 100,000'
verifications.reasoning: Range 50-100k overlaps with sources' estimates.

verifications.claim: About 50,000 to 100,000 people witnessed the sky clear on October 13, 1917.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'nearly 70,000... “clouds separated…and the sun appeared... clear blue'
verifications.reasoning: Same crowd witnessed sky clearing as part of miracle.

verifications.claim: About 50,000 to 100,000 people witnessed the sun spin on October 13, 1917.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'nearly 70,000... huge ball began to “dance”... whirled rapidly'; R3: 'Sun appeared as... spinning disc'
verifications.reasoning: Same crowd size for described phenomenon.

verifications.claim: About 50,000 to 100,000 people witnessed the sun emit colors on October 13, 1917.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'nearly 70,000... flinging out all sorts of brilliant colors'; R3: 'cast multicolored lights'
verifications.reasoning: Same crowd witnessed colors.

verifications.claim: About 50,000 to 100,000 people witnessed the sun appear to plunge toward the earth on October 13, 1917.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'nearly 70,000... plunge in a mighty zigzag course toward the earth'; R3: 'careened towards the Earth'
verifications.reasoning: Same crowd for plunge description.

verifications.claim: Fátima was once a small village.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'tiny village... most of the villagers kept herds of sheep and depended on subsistence farming'
verifications.reasoning: R2 confirms it was a small village.

verifications.claim: Fátima was named after a Moorish princess.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'name... rendition of... Fátima... Moorish princess kidnapped... Fatima fell in love... place name recalls the princess'
verifications.reasoning: R2 provides the etymology.

verifications.claim: Pope Pius XII designated the sanctuary as a minor basilica in 1954.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'raised the Sanctuary of Fátima to the status of a minor basilica... 11 November 1954... apostolic letter Luce superna'
verifications.reasoning: R3 confirms Pius XII and 1954.

verifications.claim: The Shrine of Fátima includes the Chapel of the Apparitions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Chapel of the Apparitions'; R3: 'Chapel of the Apparitions of Fátima'
verifications.reasoning: Both list it as part of the sanctuary/shrine.

verifications.claim: The Shrine of Fátima includes the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary'; R3: 'Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly part of shrine complex.

verifications.claim: The Shrine of Fátima includes the modern Basilica of the Most Holy Trinity.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Basilica of the Holy Trinity... built on the other side... early 21st century'; 'Basílica da Santíssima Trindade'
verifications.reasoning: R2 describes it as modern (early 21st century) part of sanctuary.
